title: Snapshot envelope v1
description: FROZEN at WP0 (D13, 2026-08-25) — the hub<->connector contract. Every connector writes exactly one envelope per run to the snapshot store; the hub renders tiles from envelopes only. Any change after this commit is a dated DECISIONS.md entry plus a full hub-test-suite re-run. Frozen connector id namespace: open_meteo, gcal, clickup, macromates, home_assistant, jellyfin, nas_stats, money. Changelog: media_status added 2026-10-05 (authorised dated decision, Media area Phase 1); arr added 2026-10-05 (authorised dated decision, Media area Phase 2); jellyseerr added 2026-10-05 (authorised dated decision, Media area Phase 3); qbittorrent added 2026-10-06 (authorised dated decision, Media area downloads). Owner rule (R12): any person-scoped list inside `data` carries an `owner` field valued you|her|shared on every record. `fetched_at` is the last fetch ATTEMPT; `updated_at` is the last SUCCESS and is what the hub's stale badge reads.

connector.description: Frozen id namespace. clickup is reserved (WP26 removed from v1, 2026-08-25) — the id stays frozen so a future connector needs no schema change.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last fetch ATTEMPT, success or not.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last SUCCESSFUL fetch — the hub's stale badge reads this.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason when status=error; null when ok.

data.description: Connector-specific payload. Per-feed data schemas are authored in WP23. Any person-scoped list herein carries owner: you|her|shared on every record (R12).
